forecast.insight.up: {{commodity}} prices are expected to rise about {{pct}}% over the next {{months}} month(s), mainly because of {{driver1}} and {{driver2}}.
forecast.insight.down: {{commodity}} prices are expected to fall about {{pct}}% over the next {{months}} month(s), mainly because of {{driver1}} and {{driver2}}.
forecast.insight.flat: {{commodity}} prices are expected to stay roughly stable over the next {{months}} month(s). The main factors are {{driver1}} and {{driver2}}.
seasonal.insight: {{commodity}} is usually most expensive in {{peak}} and cheapest in {{low}}.
seasonal.insufficient: There is not yet enough history to describe a seasonal pattern.
rec.sell_now.title: Sell now
rec.sell_now.rationale: Prices are forecast to drop about {{pct}}% within {{months}} month(s). Selling now avoids the expected decline.
rec.sell_now.perishable: {{commodity}} is highly perishable, so storage losses would likely outweigh any price gain from waiting.
rec.hold.title: Hold if you can store safely
rec.hold.rationale: Prices are forecast to rise about {{pct}}% within {{months}} month(s), historically peaking in {{peak}}.
rec.alt_market.title: Consider {{market}}
rec.alt_market.rationale: {{market}} ({{distance}} km away) is paying about {{margin}}% more than your market.
rec.plant.title: Plant {{commodity}}
rec.plant.rationale: Planting now in {{region}} means harvesting in {{harvest}}, when prices have historically been {{pct}}% above the yearly average.
advice.heavy_rain: Heavy rain expected ({{mm}} mm over 3 days). Delay spraying and fertiliser application, and clear drainage channels.
advice.dry_spell: Little rain is expected for the next {{days}} days. Irrigate where you can and mulch to keep soil moisture.
advice.heat_stress: High temperatures (up to {{temp}}°C) expected. Water crops early in the morning and shade nurseries.
advice.fall_armyworm_risk: Warm, humid conditions favour fall armyworm. Scout maize fields twice a week and act early.
advice.fungal_risk: Long humid spells raise the risk of fungal disease. Improve air flow and use approved fungicides if needed.
advice.good_planting_window: Rainfall looks favourable for planting in the coming week.
advice.harvest_dry_window: A dry spell is coming. This is a good window to harvest and dry produce.

knowledge.fertiliser_safety: Guidance only, from a reviewed recommendation. Soils differ: a soil test and your local extension officer give the best advice. Wear gloves, keep fertiliser away from children, food and water sources, and never apply more than recommended.
knowledge.chemical_safety: Use only products registered in your country, follow the label exactly, wear protective clothing, and respect the pre-harvest interval. Never mix chemicals or store them near food.
